what: Proteina-Complexa: NVIDIA's flow-matching binder generator (a 160 M-parameter 'local latents' transformer denoiser, 14 layers x 768, pair-biased attention, fp32 + TF32) — per design, 400 integration steps over the binder's CA coordinates and per-residue 8-dim latents conditioned on a target structure and hotspots, then a frozen autoencoder decodes the binder's atoms AND sequence; one PDB per design (chain A = the target crop, chain B = the binder). Stock = the upstream repository at the pin installed editable with pip, run through its own console script `complexa generate` on the shipped binder pipeline config — mode off; what the run computes (the generation stage alone = ++generation.search.algorithm=single-pass ++generation.reward_model=null, the seed, the batch, the design count) through upstream's own overrides after `--` (none given = the shipped configuration: best-of-n search scored by upstream's structure-prediction reward model).

proteinfoundation.console_script: complexa = proteinfoundation.cli.cli_runner:main (pyproject.toml [project.scripts]); `complexa generate <config.yaml> <overrides…>` execs `python -m proteinfoundation.generate --config-path <abs dir> --config-name <stem> ++job_id=0 ++base_config_name=<stem> <overrides> ++run_name=<run> ++gen_njobs=1` under the same interpreter with the caller's environment (cli_runner.py:633-666)
proteinfoundation.package_layout: src layout: the importable package is <checkout>/src/proteinfoundation (175 files, 172 *.py)

configs.carried: stock/src/configs/… (byte copies of the checkout's files at the pin)
configs.note: The Hydra files that define the pipeline the stock route runs: search_binder_local_pipeline.yaml (defaults: pipeline/binder/binder_generate@generation; seed 5; ckpt keys) -> binder_generate.yaml (dataloader batch_size 16, nres.nsamples 4, nrepeat 1, the target features, the search/reward blocks — best-of-n scored by upstream's structure-prediction reward model as shipped; the caller's ++generation.search.algorithm=single-pass ++generation.reward_model=null select the generation stage alone) -> model_sampling.yaml (nsteps 400, self-conditioning, schedules, sc noise scale 0.1, t_lim_ode 0.98) -> base_gen_data.yaml; check_pins.py requires these present in $LOCAL_CODE_PATH (the checkout at the pinned, clean commit already fixes their bytes); configs/targets/targets_dict.yaml is not pinned: a run given --input injects its own target entry by override and reads no shipped entry

command.stock_route: complexa generate $LOCAL_CODE_PATH/configs/search_binder_local_pipeline.yaml --verbose [++generation.task_name=<item> ++generation.target_dict_cfg={<item>:{source:'…',target_filename:'…',target_path:'<abs>',target_input:'A<first>-<last>',hotspot_residues:['A56',…],binder_length:[L,L],pdb_id:null}}] ++ckpt_path=$CKPT_PATH ++autoencoder_ckpt_path=$CKPT_PATH/complexa_ae.ckpt [<the caller's Hydra overrides and generate options after `--`, verbatim and last>]
command.overrides: upstream's own knobs, given after `--` and appended verbatim, in order and LAST (e.g. ++run_name=<run> ++generation.search.algorithm=single-pass ++generation.reward_model=null ++generation.dataloader.dataset.nres.nsamples=<n> ++seed=<s> ++generation.dataloader.batch_size=<B>, any other Hydra override, --job-id N); none given = the shipped configuration (best-of-n search, 2 replicas per design, scored by upstream's structure-prediction reward model, whose parameters it reads under $AF2_DIR; 4 designs, seed 5, dataloader batch 16, run name search_binder_local); a token for a key the package also spells (checkpoints, task/target entry) comes later on the command line and is the one Hydra applies — nothing is reserved, refused or added
command.generation_stage: the generation stage alone — one pass of the denoiser + the autoencoder decode per design, no reward model evaluated — is upstream's own pair of overrides ++generation.search.algorithm=single-pass ++generation.reward_model=null, given by the caller after `--` like any other knob; the package adds neither
command.cwd: the pass directory (--out): upstream roots its outputs at ./inference/<config>_<task>_<run>/ and its logs at ./logs relative to the working directory (generate.py:56-61, cli_runner.py LOG_DIR); ++root_path is not used because generate.py:568-576 then skips setup() and with it lightning.seed_everything
command.verbose: --verbose makes upstream's wrapper run the generate child with inherited streams (cli_runner.py:752-754) instead of filtering them into ./logs/<step>.log (:756-789): output routing only, so upstream's own log lines reach the run transcript; no numeric effect
command.entry_keys: targets_dict.yaml's own form is seven keys: source and target_filename are inert when target_path is set but binder_generate.yaml:33's oc.select fallback interpolates ${...source}/${...target_filename} eagerly (a five-key entry raises InterpolationKeyError there); the package composes whatever keys the entry file carries and checks none of them — upstream's configuration answers
command.entry_token: the entry is ONE dictionary token ++generation.target_dict_cfg={<item>:{…}}: Hydra applies a dictionary value with OmegaConf.update(merge=True) (the item is added to upstream's table, nothing else changes); the dotted per-key form target_dict_cfg.<item>.<key>=… is not used because Hydra's KEY grammar cannot spell a path element starting with a digit (1gpbA_N200 -> 'extraneous input … expecting EQUAL') while a dictionary key inside a VALUE may (read back as the string)
command.optional_tokens: the task and target-entry tokens only with --input (else the caller's ++generation.task_name=… names an entry of upstream's own table or of a ++generation.target_dict_cfg={…} merge of theirs); the run name is the caller's ++run_name=<run> (else the shipped search_binder_local)

files.role: denoiser (Proteina, 160 M parameters; ckpt_name of the pipeline config)
autoencoder (decodes latents to atoms + sequence; autoencoder_ckpt_path)

weights.source: hf:nvidia/NV-Proteina-Complexa-Protein-Target-160M-v1 @ ffed199e32612b98ffa04f4640d34d37b137fca5 (upstream `complexa download` / env/download_startup.sh fetch the same files)
weights.license: NVIDIA Open Model License (stock/src/licenses/license_weights.txt): models commercially usable, derivative models allowed, no ownership claim on outputs
weights.loader: generate.py load_ckpt_n_configure_inference (:170-200): Proteina.load_from_checkpoint(<ckpt_path>/<ckpt_name>) then the autoencoder from autoencoder_ckpt_path; validate_checkpoint_paths (:81-120) refuses missing files before anything loads

settings.designs_note: designs = ++generation.dataloader.dataset.nres.nsamples (shipped 4, binder_generate.yaml:26) x ++generation.dataloader.dataset.nrepeat_per_sample (shipped 1, :28): the number of PDBs a run writes and the census counts; given after `--` the tokens replace the shipped values (the workload, not a numeric setting)
settings.seed_note: 5 = search_binder_local_pipeline.yaml:30; upstream applies lightning.seed_everything(seed + job_id) itself (generate.py:72-75); ++seed=<s> given after `--` replaces it on either route, neither route adds a seed token of its own

batch.override: given after `--` as ++generation.dataloader.batch_size=<B> (upstream's own Hydra override) on either route; 16 when none is given

settings.shipped_sampling: no sampling token is passed by the package: nsteps 400, self_cond True, guidance_w 1.0, ag_ratio 0.0, bb_ca schedule log p 2.0 / gt 1/t p 1.0, local_latents schedule power p 2.0 / gt tan p 1.0, sampling_mode sc, sc_scale_noise 0.1, t_lim_ode 0.98 (model_sampling.yaml:10-55) — opt/complexa_opt/settings.py SHIPPED lists each with its file and line and the tests hold the list to the carried configs

modes.off: stock: the pinned command + the caller's Hydra overrides after `--` verbatim and last, cwd = the run directory; upstream's console script on upstream's installed code, nothing staged or patched
modes.exact: the stock command with COMPLEXA_OPT=exact in the child: levers onehot_f32, target_hoist, pair_assembly, loop_desync installed inside upstream's generation process by the autoload hook (opt/complexa_opt/levers.py) — byte-identical designs
modes.fast: the stock command with COMPLEXA_OPT=fast: exact's levers + pair_bias_fused + attn_sdpa — tolerance class; the default mode
modes.big: the stock command with COMPLEXA_OPT=big: exact's levers + pair_bias_rows — byte-identical designs at about a third of stock's peak memory
modes.default_mode: fast, as for every mode table of this release: a run naming no mode (no --mode, no COMPLEXA_OPT) is a fast run

pinned_stack.tested_on: the pinned Proteina-Complexa stack (Debian 12, CPython 3.12.10 under /usr/local, torch 2.7.0+cu126, the pinned checkout at /opt/pc installed editable) on NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 and, the same stack and image, on NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB — a documentation line: nothing reads or compares against it
image_recipe: base: the official python:3.12.10-slim-bookworm image (Debian GNU/Linux 12, CPython 3.12.10 at /usr/local: python / python3.12) plus Debian's build-essential, git, wget, gfortran, libxrender1 with their recommended packages

the stack: environment/requirements.lock (the one list of the tested versions; `pip install --no-deps -r`, environment/Dockerfile) — upstream's env/build_uv_env.sh set as tested: torch 2.7.0 (CUDA 12.6), torch_geometric 2.8.0 + the pt27cu126 extension wheels, lightning 2.5.6, hydra-core 1.3.1, atomworks 2.2.1, numpy 2.5.1, the optional AF2-reward extra (jax 0.4.29 cuda12)

upstream: stock/proteina-complexa-916eaaed.tar.gz unpacked to "$LOCAL_CODE_PATH" (/opt/pc in the image) && pip install --no-deps -e "$LOCAL_CODE_PATH" -e "$LOCAL_CODE_PATH/community_models/colabdesign"; then run.sh install (README.md 'Setup')
no flash-attn, no cuequivariance-torch, no xformers, no deepspeed (upstream's generation path uses none: attention is PairBiasAttention, einsum + softmax in fp32)
pinned_stack.gpu_class: H100 80GB HBM3 (sm90), configs/h100.env MODEL_OPT_TARGET_GPU=H100; A100 80GB or 40GB (sm80), configs/a100.env MODEL_OPT_TARGET_GPU=A100 — nothing in the kit reads the card's memory size (the dataloader batch is the caller's Hydra token)
pinned_stack.torch_line_note: torch 2.7.0 with CUDA 12.6 is the line upstream's env/build_uv_env.sh installs (torch==2.7.0 from the cu126 index; the PyG extension wheels are the pt27cu126 builds); the PyPI wheel's torch.__version__ reads 2.7.0+cu126
pinned_stack.precision: fp32 weights and activations; upstream sets torch.set_float32_matmul_precision('high') (TF32 matmul) in generate.py:596 and leaves cudnn TF32 at PyTorch's default (on); no autocast, no torch.compile
pinned_stack.reference_note: the pinned stack is asserted by content on whatever box runs it — check_pins.py PINNED (the installed version, the checkout's commit and cleanliness under src/ and configs/, the config files' presence), these version pins (a label check_pins reports, never a gate); tested_on names the box the kit was tested on

accelerators.attention: PairBiasAttention (pair-biased multi-head attention written as einsum + softmax in fp32); the config's attention plumbing selects nothing else
accelerators.flash_attn / memory-efficient SDPA / cue: none: not imported by the generation path and not installed on the image
accelerators.note: report-only: what upstream's generation path engages as installed; no route changes a numeric setting

stock_environment.note: COMPLEXA_OPT is this package's mode variable; COMPLEXA_KIT* is reserved for the kit levers a later release drops in; the numeric overrides NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE / CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG / TORCH_FORCE_NO_WEIGHTS_ONLY_LOAD would change stock numerics or the checkpoint loader and are stripped then proven absent; upstream's own variables (LOCAL_CODE_PATH, COMPLEXA_INIT, DATA_PATH, AF2_DIR, the JIT cache dirs, the stubbed optional-tool paths) come from the environment (configs/h100.env; README 'Variables') and are recorded as present; USE_V2_COMPLEXA_ARCH unset = the v1 architecture of the protein-target model; the tree location reaches the stock process as MODEL_OPT (run.sh's name for this directory)
